svg.content: <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" type="device"><diagram id="13-content" name="13 · Reel, Series and sharing entities"><mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" page="0" pageWidth="2495.0" pageHeight="1666.992" shadow="0" adaptiveColors="auto" scopeDescription="Implemented entities and conceptual associations; database enforcement is stated in the constraint note." schemaConstraints="UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys. UNIQUE(seriesId,episodeNumber) orders episodes. ViewSession PK is (userId,reelId,playbackSessionId). ViewEvent UNIQUE(userId,reelId,playbackSessionId,sequence). Outbox aggregate and playback-session correlation links have no declared FK. series: seriesId; nullable; onDelete SetNull (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); reel: reelId; Cascade delete (declared SQL FK); aggregate: aggregateId when aggregateType=REEL (logical) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); playback session: userId + reelId + playbackSessionId correlation (scalar-ID association; no declared FK)"><root><mxCell id="0" style="fontFamily=Arial;"
